mechanism: position-conditioned counterfactual CLIP stop discriminator inside every CR-FPL LOOP iteration

counterfactual_render_contract.coordinates: linspace(0.0,2.0,129), identical for both sides and fixed before labels
counterfactual_render_contract.canonical_q: side0=-d, side1=1+d; always within the existing source trajectory support [-2,3]
counterfactual_render_contract.coordinate_units: normalized outward distance from observed state boundary
counterfactual_render_contract.identity: Articraft object_id or NJC opaque episode_id; exact geometry-index join required
counterfactual_render_contract.observed_state_only_bank: forbidden because it is not a candidate trajectory
counterfactual_render_contract.pose_formula: angle0+q*(angle1-angle0), where anglei=lower+statei_fraction*(upper-lower); never clamp continuation to URDF limits
counterfactual_render_contract.storage: stream renderer candidate mini-batches directly through frozen CLIP; never persist full RGB trajectories
counterfactual_render_contract.persisted_artifact: signed evidence [2,129,1] plus asset/render/model/config hashes and six fixed thumbnail hashes
counterfactual_render_contract.articraft_mapping: hash-bound selection-pilc-v1.json; object_id=Path.stem(archive); node8.4 SHA256(object_id) f0/f1; first bounded revolute in URDF document order
counterfactual_render_contract.njc_mapping: hash-bound public prereg; reconstruct splart-pilc-v1 opaque episode IDs with explicit f0/f1, orientation and state order; assets/${object_id}/{object.urdf,base_final.obj,lid_final.obj,qc.json}; exact joint lid_hinge

stop: a movable object exactly at its mechanical stop
an articulated part fully closed against its hard limit
an articulated joint at the end of its allowed motion
a moving part in contact with its physical motion boundary
free: a movable object with room to continue moving
an articulated part away from its mechanical stop
an articulated joint in the interior of its allowed motion
a moving part free from its physical motion boundary

model.semantic_injection: query current predicted distance, then bias-free gated residual into feedback token
model.zero_semantic: exactly recovers the geometry-only same-weight structural control
